name: Instant Saver
creator: Analator
description: Fusion Fuse for image-sequence export, automatic Loader creation and timestamped output folders. Exports PNG, JPEG, TIFF and EXR; MP4/MOV/AVI export is specifically listed for Fusion Studio. Exact Resolve edition, OS support and numeric release version are not established.
